findings.claim: T133-HYBRID model card replay coverage for operators in non-smooth proof and rewrite domains
findings.failure_mode: The model card names FM-T133-HYBRID-PROOF-UPDATE-NEG as its negative_control and also repeats the same case ID inside additional_replay_cases. This does not create a critical/high support failure because the row remains no-send formal replay, but it makes the replay inventory non-unique and weakens model-card auditability.
findings.required_repair: Remove FM-T133-HYBRID-PROOF-UPDATE-NEG from additional_replay_cases or replace the replay list with a deduplicated unique case-id set while keeping it as the single negative_control.
